content_data.project_title: Pan-European Market Expansion for Novel Oncology Therapeutic
content_data.project_description: Proposal for a strategic initiative to penetrate key European markets with our lead oncology therapeutic, leveraging data-driven insights for optimized sales and market share growth.
content_data.timeline: 18 months, with initial market entry in the first 6 months and full regional rollout over the subsequent 12 months.
objectives: Exceed initial revenue targets for the novel therapeutic by 15% within the first 18 months.
deliverables: KOL engagement plan and initial relationship establishment reports.
success_metrics: Percentage of target physicians prescribing the therapeutic.
revenue_targets: Generate €30M in cumulative revenue by the end of the 18-month project timeline.
